definition: Arabic Ontology is a website offering linguistic ontology services for the Arabic language which can be used like the online site WordNet.
details: Users can use Arabic Ontology to classify or clarify the concepts and meanings of Arabic terms.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is Arabic Ontology — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
